text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for Zenith's private VPC — region health + a couple of action items. TL;DR: us-east1 stable, eu-west1 had a latency bump tied to a networking flit, ap-southeast1 saw a KMS rotation failure Wed that caused token errors for ~6m, spend +18% w/w from load tests. Link to graphs: https://dashboard.redwood.dev/customers/zenith/health
ash_engineer: Thanks — can you drop region-by-region numbers?
liam_sre: I'll paste the summary I'm seeing in SCOM shortly.
maria_cs: us-east1: uptime 99.99%, p50 latency 38ms, error rate 0.04%, tokens 1.2M (week). eu-west1: uptime 99.6% (brief 9m degradation Tue 21:10 UTC), p50 72ms, error rate 0.3%, tokens 620k. ap-southeast1: uptime 98.2% during rotation window, p50 120ms, error rate temporarily 1.8% at peak, tokens 760k. Spend: $23.6k this week vs $20.0k last week (+18%).
ash_engineer: ap-southeast1 KMS rotate failed on the control-plane side. Error surface: KMS returned 500 "key not found" during rotation job. Retry succeeded after fallback to cached key; root cause still under investigation. Here's the relevant log snippet:
```
KMS rotate failed: 500 KMS-ERR: key not found
module: kms/rotate.go:142
retry: attempt 3 -> success
request_id: b3c9f2d4
```
liam_sre: We saw a correlated spike in 429s from the serving layer during that 6m window — concurrent token refreshes queued up. I've created a short-lived incident for tracking. Incident ID: ZEN-3139. deploy-bot: Incident created ZEN-3139 by liam_sre. Status: investigating.
jon_sales: Heads-up — customer success mentioned they ran heavy model calibration tests mid-week which drove the spend. They flagged the KMS blip as "customer-visible" and asked if this would affect the renewal conversation.
priya_enablement: I spoke to their engineering lead yesterday — they're mildly concerned but appreciated the fast retries. They asked for a 30-45m enablement on best practices for rotations and key vaulting. Can we schedule next week?
maria_cs: action items: 1) Ash to follow up on KMS rotation root cause and mitigation (auto-backoff / circuit-breaker tuning). 2) Liam to post detailed 1h graph + 1d comparison to the incident thread. 3) Enablement session for Zenith (Priya to propose slots). 4) Sales ping for renewal touchpoint if we don't get usage back to baseline in 2 weeks.
ash_engineer: Confirming — I'll capture the rotation job runbook, add a guard to avoid full control-plane retries when key lookup returns 404/410, and add a metric for KMS rotate failure rate. ETA: EOD tomorrow for PR.
liam_sre: Posted graphs here: https://dashboards.redwood.dev/d/zenith/region-latency?from=-24h. Short-term mitigations: bump KMS client retry jitter, increase KV cache TTL for control-plane (safe for 12h) — runs best-effort.
priya_enablement: Proposed slots: Tue 09:30 or Thu 15:00 PT. I'll ping their calendar and confirm.
jon_sales: I'll join the enablement call — also will surface a note to account exec that spend bumped due to internal tests, not production issues. Helps renewal.
maria_cs: Also capturing qualitative feedback: they liked the console traces but want a clearer breakdown of token vs infra spend on the invoice. Can finance/console team look at a one-pager we can share?
ash_engineer: Noted. I'll add a small telemetry tag to separate "calibration" workloads from prod (customer can opt-in).
liam_sre: Final note: eu-west1 latency bump appears unrelated to KMS — looking like a transient peering flap with partner backbone, NOC already engaged. Keeping an eye.
maria_cs: Thanks all — will close this thread after we have the PR link and enablement slot. :thumbsup:
